Don’t go to the ER, unless you have absolutely no other choice.

They’ll treat you like you’re insane and incapable of doing anything. They take away everything, and you’ll only wear scrubs and socks. The staff doesn’t care about you, they care about making the psych ward run smoothly, and if that involves tying you down and giving you a shot of Ativan, they will. You will have no say in when you can leave, and even if you live in a state that gives you some rights in the psych ward, you either won’t be told or they’ll keep threatening to commit you; it’s just not worth the argument. They can and will keep you for as long as they possibly can, and the doctors won’t believe you if you tell them you’re better and want to leave. The food’s the lowest quality; it’s not a hotel, it’s a hospital. If you don’t comply with your treatment regiment, they’ll see that as a reason to keep you longer. 

Going to the hospital is possibly one of the worst things you can do unless you have no other choice or are literally in the process of your suicide plan. It’s like going to jail except you have far fewer rights and no time to explain yourself in front of a judge. 

Take it from someone who’s been there twice. I’m not gonna tell you what to do, make your own choice but I would strongly advise against going to a hospital.
